title: Time Limit for Removing Difficulty
description: Exception to the power of the Central Government to make orders for removing difficulties

content.general_rule: The Central Government may make provisions to remove difficulties in giving effect to the provisions of this Act
content.exception: No such order shall be made after the expiry of a period of two years from the commencement of this Act
conditions: the expiry of a period of two years from the commencement of this Act
